brand.name: Trademark Vertex
brand.tagline: Federal trademark filing, search, monitoring and renewal support for US brand owners.

contact.responseTime: We reply to every message within one business day.

items.quote: I had no idea which class my products belonged in and the USPTO site was no help at all. They mapped it out, rewrote my description of goods so it would actually pass, and filed within two days.
items.name: Alyssa K.

items.quote: We got an office action six weeks in and I assumed the application was dead. The response they prepared addressed the examiner's point directly and the mark went through to publication.
items.name: Jordan P.

items.quote: The comprehensive search paid for itself. It turned up a common-law user in our exact space that a basic USPTO lookup never would have shown, and we changed the name before spending on packaging.
items.name: Nicole R.

items.quote: Straight answers, no upsell pressure, and a real person replying to email. After two agencies that felt like call centres, that was the whole difference.
items.name: Marcus D.

items.quote: They caught that my specimen showed the logo as decoration rather than as a brand, which would have been an instant refusal. Reshot it, filed it, registered.
items.name: Priya S.

items.quote: Monitoring flagged a confusingly similar filing in our class two months after registration. We were able to act early instead of finding out from a customer.
items.name: Ben T.

pricing.heading: Straightforward pricing, no surprise line items
pricing.note: Government filing fees are billed separately and paid directly to the USPTO. Our fee covers preparation, classification and filing.
